h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Eluru

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Eluru

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Eluru

c: Eluru lies in the Godavari delta, close to Kolleru lake, and it stays humid for much of the year. Damp air is the main thing to plan for when you buy outdoor gym equipment here. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness machines to schools, colleges, housing layouts, bank and office campuses and municipal parks in Eluru. We make them at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 920 km away, and bring them by road.

Our frames are galvanised pipe, which resists rust, and the seats and pedals are roto-moulded plastic, which does not corrode. That combination suits the coastal Andhra climate. We install through our own team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh, grouted where the ground is soft. Share the plot size and a few photos. We will send back a layout drawing that shows each machine and the clear space it needs, and you approve it before we manufacture.

richText.heading: A simple maintenance routine for delta weather

c: Wet months and cyclone rains from the Bay of Bengal leave water and silt on the machines. Rinse them after heavy rain, wipe the moving joints and tighten any loose bolts. Bearings carry a 1-year warranty and are the first parts to check.

items.q: Will outdoor gym machines rust in Eluru's humid weather?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the seats are roto-moulded plastic, so they resist rust. Rinse off silt after heavy rain and check the bolts and bearings regularly.

items.q: Which part of the machine needs the most care?
items.a: The moving joints and bearings. Wipe and inspect them after the rains. Bearings carry a 1-year warranty, while galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years.

items.q: Do you deliver to Eluru and nearby delta towns?
items.a: Yes. We send the machines by road from our Vasai factory and install them with our own team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh. Soft delta soil usually calls for a grouted base.
